explanation: The Alon–Tarsi short cycle cover conjecture (1985), Conjecture 4 in Ferrarini–Mkrtchyan: every bridgeless graph has a cycle cover of total length ≤ (7/5)|E|. The file states the simple-graph specialization, which the docstring says explicitly. A multiset of cycles allows repetitions, and covering means every edge lies on some cycle. The simple-graph case is itself open. The statement is faithful, as a documented specialization.
